d: He was more than a poet, more than a statesman & more than a Prime Minister. Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee's biopic, Main Atal Hoon, starring Pankaj Tripathi in the lead role, is a film on the extraordinary life of the leader you knew but the man you didn't,. Directed by National Awardee Ravi Jadhav, and written by Rishi Virmani and Ravi Jadhav, "Main ATAL Hoon" presented by Bhanushali Studios Limited and Legend Studios, is produced by Vinod Bhanushali, Sandeep Singh, and Kamlesh Bhanushali.
